items.name: Nepal Open 2018

venue.name: [Kathmandu University](http://ku.edu.np/)
venue.details: Chinese Hall (Day 1), C.v Raman Auditorium (Day 2) follow the directions Indicated by the indicators from the main gate.

items.information:
This competition is the third iteration of **Nepal Open (Nepali National Championship)** and is open to competitors of all nationalities. However,  only **Nepalese participants** will be eligible for prizes and titles. 

यो प्रतियोगिता नेपाल ओपन (नेपाली राष्ट्रिय प्रतिस्पर्धा)को तेस्रो शृङ्खला हो र यो सबै राष्ट्रियताको प्रतियोगीका लागि खुला छ। तर उपाधि तथा पुरस्कार प्राप्त गर्न नेपाली प्रतियोगी मात्रै योग्य हुने छन्।



Pre-registration on the WCA website is compulsory. All participants wishing to compete will have to register through this [link](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NepalOpen2018/register). 

डब्लूसीएको औपचारिक वेबसाइटमा अग्रिम दर्ता गर्न अनिवार्य रहेको छ। सहभागी हुन इच्छुक महानुभावहरूले यस [लिङ्कबाट](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NepalOpen2018/registe)दर्ता गर्नु होस् ।



Please make sure to check the [Travel](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NepalOpen2018#7837-travel) and [Accomodation](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NepalOpen2018#7836-accommodation) tabs.

items.name: MPEI Open 2018

venue.name: [Moscow Power Engineering Institute](http://www.mpei.ru)
venue.details: Building "MPEI House of Culture", address Energeticheskiy Proyezd 3А

items.information:
Обратите особое внимание, что для несовершеннолетних участников в день проведения соревнований необходимо наличие на руках оригинала заполненного согласия от одно из родителей (законных представителей). Его бланк Вы можете скачать на сайте Чемпионата MPEI Open 2018 speedcubing.mpei.ru.

Pay special attention that participants under 18 years old must have the permition form from one of the parents (legal representatives) with them on the day of the competition. You can download this form on the website of the MPEI Open 2018 Championship speedcubing.mpei.ru.
